scope: First API foundation batch: owned nonsecret configuration, manual models, capability observations, parameter validation, immutable request preparation and identity projections. No outbound model request.
implementation: API configuration lives in a host-supplied shared Store aggregate with its own domain/version. API connections are not mirrored into the generic write-connection configuration store; no second Operation ledger or secret store was added.

Multiple Connection identities, own revisions, explicit protocol/endpoint mode, nonsecret credential ID/revision references, enablement and parameters; manual models are Connection-scoped and remain capability-unknown until the trusted adapter observation port supplies matching evidence.
Connection and model reads/lists require exact permissions; per-object lists derive matching-principal reads and recheck before returning. Missing projection binding cannot reveal collection size.

Configuration writes preserve scoped business intents with prepared/committed records in real SQLite. Lost acknowledgements recover by original intent; unresolved prepared records are observation-only, not blindly re-executed.

Preparation checks current Connection/Model revisions, matching evidence revision, enabled state, protocol and observed capability. Parameter types/ranges/enums and explicit value/default/disabled modes are validated. Conflicting sources are rejected; no override precedence was chosen.

OpenAI-Chat-compatible text request plans preserve endpoint prefixes/full routes, 0/false/null and supported structured parameter values. Deep-frozen snapshots retain credential references and explicit setting provenance/fingerprints, never resolved secrets. Media/tool-message inputs are rejected, not dropped.
Permission-scoped API/Model identity projections support real Space references. Registered identity is distinct from a live Provider/model capability test.

Closed-input schemas, reserved native fields, endpoint credentials/query fragments, unsafe remote HTTP, corrupt/future formats, ID collisions and reentrant service stop are rejected. Loopback HTTP metadata can be registered.

verification.command: stop inside permission recheck regression (before fix)
isolated API public-entry strict TypeScript compilation
verification.qualification: Transitive shared/permissions dependencies compile; no package isolation claim.

fixtures: host identity binding and management approval facts
assertions: Missing configuration grant does not create API metadata.
A Space association needs an independent API model-read grant.
Revoking model-read permission hides the Space projection; restoring permission preserves the relation ID.
Space does not receive API credential-reference metadata.

coverage.API-01: Partial: independent Connection configuration CRUD subset (create/edit/read/list/enablement). Copy, defaults and destructive deletion are not implemented.
coverage.API-02: Partial: manual models, local directory, provenance-bearing trusted capability observations. Remote model listing/probing adapters are not implemented.
coverage.API-03: Credential references only; no platform credential backend or real connectivity test.
coverage.API-04: Prepared text request plan/body only. No HTTP transport, response generation, SSE decoder, terminal handling, producer backpressure or cancellation/timeout execution.
coverage.API-05: Tool input/intent handling not implemented; unsupported tool messages/fields are rejected.
coverage.API-07: Loopback endpoint metadata supported; no model runtime or actual local-provider invocation.
coverage.API-08: Explicit Connection/Model selection and immutable snapshot; no automatic routing.
coverage.API-09: Timeout intent captured in plan; no network timers, retries or fallback. Configuration commit-unknown handling is not model-request recovery.
coverage.API-10: Automatic failover remains unimplemented and policy-dependent.

limits: Only openai-chat request preparation is implemented. Other protocol metadata can be saved, but prepare explicitly rejects unsupported protocols.
Endpoint validation initially refuses URL queries/fragments; provider-specific query routes are not yet supported. This is not full Azure/Google endpoint support.

Observed capability provenance comes from an injected trusted synchronous reader of existing evidence, not an implicit network probe. Capability TTL/refresh policy and actual provider verification remain pending.
Snapshot output size is bounded; no claim of bounded streaming queues or producer backpressure is made.
No Pi AI dependency or SDK replacement was adopted. Historical strict decoder/continuation assets and research were not deleted or altered.
No OpenAI/DeepSeek account credentials were inspected, provisioned or used. Actual provider generation, tool round trips, credential delivery and Windows integration are NOT_RUN.
App automatic API-store lifecycle wiring is pending; the host must own Store/lock lifetime. This batch only exercises explicit real composition.
Descriptor files, layered parameter precedence, automatic switching and destructive lifecycle policies remain unfrozen/unimplemented.
next: Controlled credential/transport and strict response streaming slice, retaining historical negative vectors and explicit Provider integration evidence.
